selected_revision.selection: Selected public release for the FUSOU adapter boundary. The observed refs/heads/main commit 0fe3c32d35382b3f290a43c4156399ca4512bb89 is 0.1.0-alpha.16-pre and remains excluded until released and re-reviewed.

dependency_lock.source: upstream Cargo.lock at the selected commit

linked_dependencies.tlsn-attestation: git dependency at selected commit; used for Presentation decode and verify
linked_dependencies.tlsn-core: git dependency at selected commit; pinned alpha.15 verification graph
linked_dependencies.tlsn: not linked; prover/runtime crate is not required by the offline Presentation verifier

fusou_adapter_boundary.pinning_rule: The adapter may use only the selected revision and the lock records above. The FUSOU verifier links tlsn-attestation and tlsn-core at the selected commit; it must not select another TLSNotary revision implicitly. Cargo.lock remains ignored for this library package, so the selected upstream lock hash and exact git revisions remain the reproducibility record.
fusou_adapter_boundary.adapter_rule: FUSOU owns HTTP require_info framing, authenticated binding validation, strict Result parsing, one-request state, lifecycle, and transport. TLSNotary source does not provide those FUSOU guarantees.
fusou_adapter_boundary.time_rule: ConnectionInfo.time is connection-start metadata only. It is not Notary issuance time and is not copied into v1 identity authority fields.

manifest_license.tlsn-attestation: no package-level license field in the selected manifest

license_security_review.security_scope: Reviewed source and lock inputs for the selected adapter boundary, including Attestation ID exposure, header signing, BCS canonical serialization, bincode example transport, and absence of Notary-issued time.
license_security_review.disposition: This Phase 0 artifact freezes source selection and records the missing root license/NOTICE files. It does not authorize binary redistribution. Legal owner confirmation of applicable MIT/Apache terms is required before shipping or redistributing a runtime dependency.

attestation_id_profile.profile_encoding: raw opaque bytes returned by Uid.0; exactly 16 bytes for the selected revision
attestation_id_profile.json_transport: strict unpadded base64url of the exact 16 raw bytes
attestation_id_profile.database_representation: the exact 16 raw bytes; no text or re-encoding is authoritative
attestation_id_profile.claim_binding_representation: u16_be(16) followed by the exact 16 raw bytes
attestation_id_profile.signature_boundary: The Notary signature is over the BCS canonical serialization of Header, not over the ID alone. FUSOU extracts the ID only after successful TLSNotary presentation verification.
